You want 1,000 fakes. Count: progressive quotas give 2 slots, +2 per verified epoch, cap 40. A glacier of idle clones earns nothing; 19 honest epochs buys a high quota.

Cheat: count resets to 2, rewards freeze 6 epochs, repeat cheating doubles the climb. A jetty of 1,000 clones needs 19 honest epochs, about 152,000 units, before one pays off.

The canyon is the gap: forgery pays only after work you never did. Bulk fakes starve.
